glossZh: 紧接着的（因果链上的前因/后果）
glossEn: immediately before or after as in a chain of cause and effect
note: immediately before or after as in a chain of cause and effect。现有中文无对应，属新增。**这是最容易被漏掉的一条**：the immediate cause of the fire（直接原因）/ an immediate result（直接结果）。
